Q1_why_never_paper.answer: Because no strategy ever satisfied the pre-registered admission criteria, and the ledger is fail-closed: 0 of 24 are admitted_for_paper, the runtime registry refuses all 24 before a proposal exists, and every paper cycle therefore ends NO_TRADE_STRATEGIC.
decisive_evidence: c2 (net>0), c3 (PF>1), c4 (OOS>0) and c7 (2x cost) fail for every family tested at 5m
paper run paper-lab-continuous-02: 337 cycles, 0 trades, kind NO_TRADE_STRATEGIC
Q1_why_never_paper.not_a_cause: the paper lane itself was healthy: 0 runtime failures, 0 risk vetoes, state unchanged, FALSE_SUCCESS 0. No-trade is the correct output of 0 admitted strategies.

Q2_how_many_positive_net_with_sample.answer: Zero. No strategy has a positive net expectancy after the research cost line, with or without the sample test.
Q2_how_many_positive_net_with_sample.note: 7 of 24 cells are gross-positive at zero cost (best 8.912 bps/trade) and every one of them is below both cost lines, so none becomes net-positive.

Q3_dominant_limiter.answer: The cost plane, on top of a weak entry. Two failures stack: five of six families have no gross edge at all (NO_ALPHA), and the one surviving family plus the best timeframes produce a gross edge that is smaller than the round trip they must pay (EXECUTION_COST). No cell clears either cost line, so the binding constraint is the cost plane and the ceiling is the gross edge.
Q3_dominant_limiter.secondary: The evidence layer itself is incomplete (no drawdown, no observed spread, no per-timeframe admission verdict), and the legacy runner would starve five families of indicators even if they were admitted. Neither is the profitability blocker; both are blockers to promotion.

Q4_families_worth_new_experiments.answer: Only as NEW preregistered hypotheses, never as a retune of the closed ones. The evidence supports exactly three lines: (a) the 30m horizon, where the gross edge peaks (volatility +8.91, mean_reversion +5.47, trend +2.21 bps) and turnover falls; (b) the entry itself, since the direction-adjusted forward return is negative at every horizon for every family, which points at signal construction rather than exits; (c) the cost plane, where the same cadence at a maker/futures venue is 13.79 bps instead of 23.79 bps.

items: 1. At least one strategy that clears c1..c9 net of the runtime admission cost plane — nothing else in the list can be exercised before this exists.
2. A per-timeframe admission verdict and the missing metrics (max drawdown, observed spread) so the ledger is complete rather than partly unproven.
3. Runtime enablement behind admission: a router that can carry N eligible strategies, a portfolio policy for simultaneous signals, and the DEF-206 precompute fix — all only after (1).

4. Paper gate prerequisites: a clean continuous 24h window (last attempt 4.16h, 17.3% coverage, collector stopped on its own disk budget) and the M-03/M-07 history their gates require; plus the explicit operator authorization for paper promotion (currently NOT_AUTHORIZED).

Q6_next_rfc.answer: One work package is justified by the evidence: a cost-and-entry research campaign, to be registered as RFC-50 and to remain unauthorized until the operator amends the registry. Its first deliverable is not a strategy but a measured cost plane, because the evidence says the cost plane is what kills the edge.
Q6_next_rfc.allocation_rule: A new RFC number must be checked against this registry first. The next free number is the smallest integer above 046 that this registry does not list as occupied. Numbers are never reused. 045 stays empty by control: four campaign verifiers assert that no RFC-045 artefact exists, so filling it would break a real invariant rather than merely reuse a number.
Q6_next_rfc.precondition: a mechanism whose turnover-adjusted gross edge is expected to clear the frozen 23.353553391 bps per round trip at its own cadence, registered as a new hypothesis with a new id, a new experimental budget and an explicit operator authorization
